title: Motion to compel discovery responses and for sanctions
goal: Get an order compelling Cascade to produce the documents in Requests 4-11 and 16-19 and answer Interrogatories 3, 5, and 7 within 14 days, plus the fees for this motion.

background.text: The July 29 meet-and-confer was not transcribed, and our only record of Cascade's promise is our associate's email summary sent the same day.
Our client's own IT vendor did not back up the scheduling database for three weeks before the outage, which Cascade does not yet know.
Cascade's counsel has told us informally that production of engineering communications would require review of about 40,000 documents.

analysis.ask: Compel full responses and award sanctions including fees

assumptions.text: The motion is filed in a state trial court of general jurisdiction.
